name: 06716 · Wolcott, CT
findings: ZIP 06716 (Wolcott) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06716 (Wolcott) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
